purpose: Teach: 頒布/加味/横行/内職/創始/既得/代用/一掃

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 社員向け資料の頒布日を決めましょう
lines.en: Let's decide on when to distribute the staff materials.
lines.style: Crisp and professional. Clear opening. Measured pace. A question posed as a shared task, not a demand.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。プロジェクトに季節要因を加味する案です
lines.en: Yes. Here's a proposal to factor seasonal considerations into the project.
lines.style: Attentive, responsive. Light affirmation on the opening. Even tempo. Speaking as a team member offering input, not just compliance.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 業界で価格競争が横行しておりますね
lines.en: Price competition is really intense in this industry right now.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Steady, observational tone. Slight weight on the problem itself, not alarm. Testing the air.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。パート社員の内職対応を整備します
lines.en: Yes. We should get the system in place for part-time staff side work arrangements.
lines.style: Practical acknowledgment. Clear and structured. Moves forward with specifics. Reliable cadence.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 当社の創始の精神を新人研修で伝えましょう
lines.en: We should make sure to pass on the company's founding spirit in the new hire training.
lines.style: Warm conviction underneath. Measured, purposeful. Speaks like someone who believes in what she's asking for. Slight emphasis on 'should'.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。既得契約の更新も計画しております
lines.en: Yes. We're also planning to renew the existing contracts.
lines.style: Methodical. Low-key competence. Speaking of things already in motion. Even-keeled, steady.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 原料の代用案も検討してください
lines.en: Please look into alternative materials as well.
lines.style: Clear directive, not harsh. Expectant but not pressuring. Assumes capability. Quiet authority.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。不良在庫の一掃セールを準備します
lines.en: Yes. I'll get the clearance sale for the excess inventory ready.
lines.style: Closing tone. Affirming and concluding. Slightly quickened pace—wrapping up. Confident on the detail. Natural resolution.
